summary:
Unified Bidirectional Selection & Prompt-First Floating AI Menu Plan:
1. Bidirectional Homologous Selection (Source <-> Preview): Selecting text or right-clicking in either the LaTeX Source Stream or the Rendered Paper Preview resolves to a single unified selection state, automatically locating and highlighting the corresponding block/range across both panes.
2. Single Unified Floating Agent Card: Replaces the fragmented dark micro-popover and multi-item context menu with one cohesive, Apple-aesthetic frosted floating card.
3. Prompt-First Universal Design: Eliminates paper-specific hardcoded presets (e.g. CVPR / results/ / refs.bib labels) in favor of a natural language input box at the top (with @file autocomplete support) and 3 universal quick actions (Polish, Condense, Expand/Rewrite).
